module.name: plunkconnect
module.description: Connects PrestaShop to a self-hosted Plunk instance: newsletter sync (double opt-in), behavioural events, catalog feed and coupons. Replaces Newsman.
module.author: TV Parkas
module.confirmUninstall: Are you sure? All queued Plunk events will be lost. Plunk-side data is not touched.
